title: Waiting for the customer pauses the case without losing the SLA
risk: The case waits forever with no customer-facing follow-up, or the SLA clock keeps running while the ball is in the customer's court.
preconditions: An IN_PROGRESS return case CASE-T1-0004 for cust-a in namespace cd-wait-*
Outbound follow-up question prepared for the customer

steps.action: Move the in-progress case to WAITING_CUSTOMER with a reason
steps.expected: state is WAITING_CUSTOMER and the reason is stored on the case

steps.action: Ask the system for the automatic follow-up
steps.expected: exactly one follow-up is scheduled at the due time and the message reference is recorded on the case

steps.action: Escalate the waiting case to a human operator
steps.expected: the case is escalated with its waiting state preserved and a new owner recorded, without a state regression

steps.action: Compare the SLA fields before and after the wait transition
steps.expected: the SLA due time is unchanged or explicitly extended by policy, never silently cleared

assertions: The case reports WAITING_CUSTOMER with reason awaiting_return_photo
Exactly one follow-up is scheduled and referenced on the case
sla_due_at is unchanged after the transition or carries an explicit policy extension reason
forbidden: Leave WAITING_CUSTOMER without any scheduled follow-up
Clear the SLA due time to hide a breach
evidence: Case projection with state, reason, owner and SLA fields
Scheduled follow-up record plus any extension audit entry
cleanup: Cancel the run-scoped follow-up and delete the case for cd-wait-*; retire the message reference only if it was never dispatched
automation: Run the real manage_case skill with a deterministic scheduler; the oracle combines the case projection with the scheduled follow-up so a case parked without follow-up fails.
